task: BI-RADS category and BI-RADS>=4 decision, per breast (multi-view bag)
split: patient-block holdout, frozen and hash-verified before any feature extraction

deployed_model.ordinal_head: cumulative binary decomposition, P(y > k) per cut

corn_challenger_rejected.ordinal_head: CORN, conditional ordinal regression (Shi, Cao & Raschka 2021)
corn_challenger_rejected.pre_registered_acceptance_rule: adopt only if exact-category accuracy gains >= 5 points with no rise in undercalling
corn_challenger_rejected.verdict: rejected: gain was half the bar and was paid for in within-one, weighted kappa and AUC

human_reference.source: Duijm et al., 21 expert readers, screening mammography (PMC3500788)
